ModMetaData.name: [OA]Ratkin Gene Expand
ModMetaData.description:
“你我生而不同。” “You and I were born different” ~~~~~~~~~~ 虽然是鼠族基因扩展，但本模组可以不依赖鼠族模组独立运行。 Although it is a mouse gene extension, this module can operate independently without relying on the mouse module. ~~~~~~~~~~ 在未开启鼠族模组的情况下，本模组修改了塑形仓的塑形耗时与近视的具体效果，并添加了30个全新的基因。 具体塑形耗时修改： 生体递归：25天->8.2天 年龄逆转：6天->5.6天 伤口治疗：8天->4天 愉悦调整：4天->2.2天
近视效果修改：由原本的超过中远距离射击精度降低为2%，调整为射击精度部分降低。 Without activating the Rat Clan module, this module modified the shaping time and specific effects of myopia in the shaping chamber, and added 30 new genes. Specific shaping time modification: Biological recursion: 25 days ->8.2 days Age reversal: 6 days ->5.6 days Wound treatment: 8 days ->4 days Pleasure adjustment: 4 days ->2.2 days
Myopia effect modification: The shooting accuracy has been reduced from over medium to long range to 2%, and adjusted to a partial decrease in shooting accuracy. ~~~~~~~~~~ 在开启鼠族模组的情况下，本模组在上述修改的基础上，还添加了： 5个鼠族外观基因 10个新的鼠族异种 2个鼠族独有的基因建筑。 5个金鸢尾兰帝国独有的基因建筑（金鸢尾兰鼠族模组） 3个新的鼠族派系 In addition to the modifications mentioned above, this mod has also added: Five appearance genes of the mouse tribe 10 new rodent species Two unique genetic architectures of the mouse tribe. 5 unique genetic buildings of the Golden Iris Empire (Golden Iris Mouse Clan Module) Thre new factions of the Rat Clan ~~~~~~~~~~~ 除了内容更新外，还对鼠族模组数值进行了以下的调整，以适应基因环境： 有毒环境抗性：90%->50% 射击瞄准时间：118%->105% 心灵敏感度：80%->100% 修复了鼠族儿童成长过快的BUG。 In addition to content updates, the following adjustments have been made to the values of the Rat Clan module to adapt to the genetic environment: Toxic environment resistance: 90% ->50% Shooting aiming time: 118% ->105% Mental sensitivity: 80% ->100% Fixed the bug of mouse children growing too fast. ~~~~~~~~~~ 兼容性问题： 由于我个人很少采用其他与基因相关的MOD，所以如果这些MOD有改动异种相关，并且没有做兼容，那么有概率会和本模组出现冲突。 此外兼容鼠族军阀与金鸢尾兰模组，不兼容吱星人鼠族扩展。 Compatibility issues: Since I rarely use other gene related MODs personally, if these MODs have modifications related to different species and are not compatible, there is a probability that they will conflict with this module. In addition, it is compatible with the Rat Warlord and Golden Iris Orchid mod, but not compatible with the Zhi Xing Man Rat Clan extension. ~~~~~~~~~~ 制作组成员： 作用成谜的策划：默与孤 DLL代码：夜海 XML代码：夜海\默与孤 美工：焕滅Leven 文案：默与孤 翻译：百度翻译（我的GPT找不到了！） 赞助：默与孤
交流及错误反馈群：869628423 ~~~~~~~~~~ 最后，祝您游玩愉快。 愿金鸢尾兰的清香能够直达您的内心。 Finally, I wish you a pleasant gaming experience. May the delicate fragrance of Oberonia Aurea soothe your soul.
